integrity: Analytic proof provided. Exact-rational finite checks independently construct grounded matrices but do not establish the all-parameter statement or originality. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Unit-conductance complete bipartite K_(2,q) with perfect noise-free leaders; main theorem k>=4, q>=k, plus k=q+1 boundary. Does not cover weighted or general bicliques, finite grounding, or alternate noise models. Exact optimum is a leader-class characterization, not a proof of general algorithmic novelty.
title: The cubic hub-allocation threshold for multi-leader coherence on \(K_{2,q}\)
